name: Linux runtime (Ubuntu 26.04 LTS + KDE Plasma)
note: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS arm64 with KDE Plasma 6.6, KWin's Aurorae engine for the N-OS Atelier window decoration, Mesa 26.0 (Zink), Firefox from Mozilla's apt repository, Flatpak and PipeWire. No snapd. r5 adds Claude Code, openconnect with ocproxy (VPN without root), WireGuard and OpenVPN tools.
